metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2023 · The Super Mario Bros. Movie
metas.description: Brooklyn plumbers Mario and Luigi are warped to the magical Mushroom Kingdom, and Mario must team up with Princess Peach, Toad, and Donkey Kong to save Luigi from the evil Bowser.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2024 · Inside Out 2
metas.description: A sequel that features Riley entering puberty and experiencing brand new, more complex emotions as a result. As Riley tries to adapt to her teenage years, her old emotions try to adapt to the possibility of being replaced.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2023 · Elemental
metas.description: Follow Ember and Wade, in a city where fire, water, earth and air live together.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2025 · Zootopia 2
metas.description: Brave rabbit cop Judy Hopps and her friend, the fox Nick Wilde, team up again to crack a new case, the most perilous and intricate of their careers.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · Toy Story 5
metas.description: Woody, Buzz, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs are challenged when they're introduced to electronics, a new threat to playtime.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · Hoppers
metas.description: A 19-year-old animal lover uses technology that places her consciousness into a robotic beaver to uncover mysteries within the animal world beyond her imagination.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2023 · Leo
metas.description: A 74-year-old lizard named Leo and his turtle friend decide to escape from the terrarium of a Florida school classroom where they have been living for decades.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2024 · Wallace & Gromit: Vengeance Most Fowl
metas.description: Top dog Gromit springs into action to save his master when Wallace's high-tech invention goes rogue and he is framed for a series of suspicious crimes.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · Coyote vs. Acme
metas.description: After enduring years of malfunctioning products, Wile E. Coyote teams up with a local personal injury attorney to take on ACME, the manufacturer of anything and everything used by the Looney Tunes characters.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2023 · Robot Dreams
metas.description: The adventures and misfortunes of Dog and Robot in New York City during the 1980s.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · Swapped
metas.description: A tiny woodland creature and a majestic bird suddenly swap bodies, forcing them to team up to survive the wildest adventure of their lives.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2022 · The Bob's Burgers Movie
metas.description: When a sinkhole in front of Bob's Burgers threatens the Belchers' plans for a successful summer, Bob and Linda try to keep their business going, while the kids attempt to save the restaurant by solving a mystery.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2022 · Entergalactic
metas.description: Jabari, a charming, streetwear-clad artist on the cusp of real success. After a chance run-in with his cool new photographer neighbor, Meadow, Jabari has to figure out whether he can make space for love in his life.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · The Last Viking
metas.description: A bank robber released from jail must unlock his traumatised brother's memory to recover stolen loot.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2022 · Beavis and Butt-Head Do the Universe
metas.description: After a "creative" judge sentences them to space camp, a black hole sends our adolescent heroes 24 years into the modern future where the duo misuse iPhones, embark on a quest to score, and become targets of the Deep State.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2022 · The First Slam Dunk
metas.description: Follows 17-year-old Ryota Miyagi, who struggles to accomplish his late elder brother's dream of becoming a basketball star.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2023 · Spy x Family Code: White
metas.description: After receiving an order to be replaced in Operation Strix, Loid decides to help Anya win a cooking competition at Eden Academy, by making the director's favorite meal in order to prevent his replacement.
